details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_implement_prepush_test_gate.py:343-350 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_timeout_above_the_step_budget_is_clamped` asserts `"--timeout-minutes 53" in log`, but scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:670-678 clamps the value a second time (`fit_minutes=$(( (step_budget - (SECONDS - gate_started) - 120) / 60 ))` with `step_budget=3300`), so any setup time lowers it to 52 or less.
  WHY: All reviewers rated this BLOCKER: CI run 40439918197 (job 121977540147) fails with "FAILED tests/test_implement_prepush_test_gate.py::test_timeout_above_the_step_budget_is_clamped - AssertionError: assert '--timeout-minutes 53' in ...", which turns tests-hooks-and-orchestrator and the aggregate `lint` check red and blocks merge; sonnet, luna and glm say the test expectation is wrong and the script is right.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:409-416 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `implement_prepush_test_gate_build_prompt` places captured test failures after `=== CAPTURED TEST FAILURES (UNTRUSTED) ===` with no `UNTRUSTED_DATA: ` prefix on each line and no `=== END CAPTURED TEST FAILURES (UNTRUSTED) ===` marker, unlike the review-side sibling at scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:365-369.
  WHY: All reviewers rated this MAJOR: test output controlled by the PR can print forged `=== CHANGED FILES ===` or `=== EFFECTIVE REPAIR ALLOW-LIST ===` sections or instructions, and the repair editor would read them as trusted pipeline context. `neutralise()` only indents lines that start with `::`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:725-812 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `review_prepush_test_gate_integration_main` prepares the image with `prepare-ephemeral codex`, which returns at scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:126-129 before the dependency/pytest bootstrap, and calls `review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate` without `--venv` (`rpg_venv=""`), so the gate runs without pytest.
  WHY: All reviewers rated this MAJOR: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:571-572 records pytest tests as `unverified` (`pytest_unavailable`) rather than `fail`, and repair runs only on `fail && pr_caused > 0`, so post-sync test failures are never detected or repaired while each dispatch still uses an `integration_test_repair_dispatches` slot.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1010-1019 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_resolver_prepush_test_gate` uses `prepare-ephemeral codex` (line 1012) and calls `gate --phase resolver` without `--venv`, so pytest tests come back `unverified` and resolver pre-push test repair never runs.
  WHY: minimax raised this as a separate MAJOR finding; sonnet and glm raised the same blind spot inside their integration-gate finding, and glm notes that agents.d/8201 documents "no venv" for the resolver.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:3299-3307 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The resolver's own sandbox prepare for the model run also uses `prepare-ephemeral codex` without installing dependencies, so the resolver commit lands without detecting broken pytest tests.
  WHY: The resolver pre-push gate silently marks every pytest item `unverified`, and the failure only shows up in the next PR CI run, which is exactly what the gate is meant to prevent.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:273-289 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `heal_prepush_test_gate` calls `bash "${gate_step}" gate --phase heal ... --image "${image}"` without `--venv`, and the codex sandbox image does not include pytest.
  WHY: Pytest items are reported `unverified` instead of `fail`, so the heal repair turn never fires and workflow heal can never repair a pytest regression.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:670-678 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `gate_started` is set (line 558) before the image build and the staged-workspace restore/reinstall, so the dynamic `fit_minutes` clamp quietly lowers the documented 53-minute maximum to 52.
  WHY: The user's 53-minute timeout is quietly reduced, and the CI test failure is one symptom of it. Related hardening advice from sonnet, minimax and glm: lower the static clamp to 52 or document that the effective timeout can be lower.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9518 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: slop_scan reports a syntax error ("unexpected indent" parse failure) in the inline Python/bash heredoc block.
  WHY: gemini says this causes workflow/static-analysis CI failures. sonnet and glm dispute it: the line is outside every PR hunk, the parse error is advisory or not reproducible, and `static-checks` CI passed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24557-24586 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The SHA dedupe for `integration_test_repair_sha` compares against the previously recorded SHA, not the current origin HEAD, so concurrent squash-merges between the fetch and the dispatch can be missed.
  WHY: During bursts of rapid squash-merges, the second and third repair dispatches could be silently skipped and their heads left unrepaired.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24593-24597 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The wrapper choice is hardcoded to the order `ai-review.yml internal-review.yml review_autofix.yml` and keyed on a `post_sync_test_repair:` declaration, which assumes consumer wrappers are passive pass-throughs.
  WHY: If a consumer wrapper ever declares the input directly, dispatch is routed to a wrapper whose handling of this input is unverified.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:818-822 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Integration dispatch is keyed on the process-wide env var `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_STEP_MODE`; if the var is unset (for example a wrong source path or `stage_workflow_support.sh` not forwarding it), the code silently falls back to `review_prepush_test_gate_main`.
  WHY: The integration step silently becomes a regular review gate, integration repair never runs, and the non-fatal outcome hides the misconfiguration.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:753-757 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The re-run budget check reads `${rpg_timeout:-15}`, which depends on the order of `review_prepush_test_gate_mode` calls, so the value flow is fragile.
  WHY: If the mode call were moved or removed, the budget check would silently fall back to 15 and skip re-runs; it is correct today but brittle.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:768 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When the first run is `unverified`, `repair` stays "not needed", so the log line says `repair=not_needed` and does not show whether the gate ran or was skipped.
  WHY: This is a readability/debuggability issue only, not a runtime correctness issue.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:314-326 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `--repair-turn` subshell redirects `GITHUB_ENV` to the throwaway file `${RUNTIME_DIR}/prepush_gate_repair_github_env`, so any future editor-hook writes to `GITHUB_ENV` would be dropped.
  WHY: This is a future-proofing concern that rests on an undocumented invariant; current behaviour (exit 80 `claude_capacity`) is tested.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24566-24574 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Every poll tick with an integration branch runs `git fetch --no-tags --quiet origin ...` even when no squash-merge has happened (default `INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_MODE=repair`).
  WHY: Fetch load rises sharply (about 1440 fetches/day vs about 24 before) and multiplies with the number of integration branches.
- scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:376-401 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `implement_prepush_test_gate_restore_symlinks` moves the symlink to a backup before `git checkout HEAD -- <path>` and has no trap or subshell, so a SIGTERM between the `mv` and the checkout (lines 391-393) leaves the worktree inconsistent.
  WHY: The race window is microseconds and unlikely, but the step's 60-minute kill can land on this path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
